title: Audited rule policy: detectors stay, enforcement goes off
summary: This change splits detection from enforcement across the osf linter. A new policy module compiles a fixed list of audited writing and skill rules to `off`, and every consumer — the CLI lint commands, the check gate, and the stop hook — merges that policy into its level map so a repository config cannot re-enable a disabled rule or disable a retained one. Alongside it, the audit's precise detector fixes land: the script-pin check becomes a token-based command registry with an explicit coverage statement, the em-dash rule narrows to U+2014, weasel-attribution accepts a labelled HTTP(S) link, commit messages stop enforcing reference-without-link, generated merge subjects are exempted, and the composite `skill-reads-as-manual` and `parenthetical` rules are removed.

nodes.label: osf lint writing
nodes.subtitle: lint_writing
nodes.summary: Runs the writing lint over files or a message and prints findings. Now emits a policy coverage line to stderr before linting.

nodes.label: osf lint skill
nodes.subtitle: lint_skill_cmd
nodes.summary: Lints a skill directory. Now merges writing and skill levels through skill_levels and prints both the script-pin coverage and the policy coverage.

nodes.label: osf check
nodes.subtitle: check_cmd
nodes.summary: The checkpoint gate. Prints policy coverage for lint-writing and lint-skill checks before running them.

nodes.label: osf explain
nodes.subtitle: explain
nodes.summary: Prints a rule's metadata. Now adds an enforcement note when the rule is disabled by default, so the detector's purpose stays documented.

nodes.label: Stop hook
nodes.subtitle: checked_findings
nodes.summary: Runs on every turn end on the fast tier. Merges the disabled writing policy over the config levels so a config override cannot re-enable an audited detector, and logs the resolved coverage.

nodes.label: Writing lint
nodes.subtitle: lints::writing::lint_writing
nodes.summary: Evaluates raw detectors for a context. Now exempts generated merge subjects in commit context, drops reference-without-link for commits, and leaves level application to consumers.

nodes.label: Writing rules
nodes.subtitle: lints::writing::rules
nodes.summary: The per-sentence detectors. em-dash narrows to U+2014, weasel-attribution accepts a labelled HTTP(S) link, and the parenthetical rule is removed.

nodes.label: Skill lint
nodes.subtitle: lints::skill
nodes.summary: Skill body and script checks. The composite skill-reads-as-manual vote is removed; script findings now delegate to the token-based script-pins check.

nodes.label: Script pin check
nodes.subtitle: lints::script_pins
nodes.summary: New literal command-token check. A shared command registry drives both detection and the mandatory coverage statement; it inspects standalone install/add/run/pull tokens and skips variables, pipelines, local paths and archives.

nodes.label: Audited policy
nodes.subtitle: lints::policy
nodes.summary: Compiles the audited disabled rule lists into Off level maps, merges writing and skill levels for skill runs, and renders the coverage statement naming what is disabled from enforcement.

nodes.label: Co-author trailer scan
nodes.subtitle: scan::coauthor_trailer_findings
nodes.summary: Now matches the Co-Authored-By field name case-insensitively while still requiring the colon.

nodes.label: Writing config
nodes.subtitle: WritingConfig
nodes.summary: Defaults now seed levels from the disabled writing policy instead of an empty map; must_explain_names is documented as read for parity only.

nodes.label: Skill config
nodes.subtitle: SkillConfig
nodes.summary: Defaults now seed levels from the disabled skill policy.

nodes.label: Gate config loader
nodes.subtitle: gate_loaded
nodes.summary: Under --gate the file's levels are ignored and compiled defaults win; must_explain_names is still read, but undefined-name is off so it adds no gate errors.

nodes.label: osf.toml
nodes.subtitle: repository config
nodes.summary: The repository's own config, with comments updated to say the must_explain_names list no longer adds gate errors.

nodes.label: Findings output
nodes.subtitle: human / json / exit code
nodes.summary: Findings after level overrides, plus the coverage lines on stderr and the gate exit code.

nodes.label: Policy and detector tests
nodes.subtitle: audited_rule_policy, audited_detector_fixes
nodes.summary: Consumer-level tests proving disabled rules do not enforce while raw fixtures still evaluate, and regression tests for each precise detector fix.
